_what: Measured baseline from the SEALED Kimi reserved run (1440/1440). Use it to judge probe P7: an arm whose output distribution sits materially above this will truncate more often at the frozen 4096 ceiling.

truncated_at_ceiling.note: finish_reason='length'. The frozen 4096 ceiling was ALREADY binding for 4% of Kimi calls. On a reasoning model whose reasoning tokens draw on the same completion budget, this rate can only go up.

qa1b_vs_qa1c.note: Confirms defect 001 from the local evidence: 35 valid answers were scored truncated because Kimi emitted the end marker as '/think' without the closing glyph.
